Sam Kininger grew up in Oriskany, NY and excelled in classical and jazz saxophone as a high school student. He is a Berklee College alumnus and has become one of the most recognized soul/jazz artists in the business. Sam has toured extensively with Soulive and Lettuce, and currently performs with the Sam Kininger Band.
Sam was interviewed in Clinton, NY on May 27, 2011 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
